2023-07-17
Rear-end collision reported by the policyholder's household member, who was driving the insured vehicle at the time.
The claimant is represented by counsel, and the file has been opened for bodily injury and property damage.
2023-08-10
Photos from the scene show the rear damage on the claimant's vehicle and a matching impact area on the insured
vehicle. Police and two bystanders confirm the claimant was in the vehicle when the collision happened. No
independent witnesses have come forward to describe how the collision occurred.
2023-08-17
The claimant reports neck and back strain, and the reported injury fits the type and froce of a rear impact. Medical
records show no prior treatment to the same body areas, and no earlier injury has been identified through the claims
database.
2023-11-01
Counsel has provided a treatment summary. Viists and new services have been added steadily over several months,
which is well beyond what this type of strain usually requires. The adjuster has requested the treatment plan and the
referral basis for each new service.
2023-11-20
The claimant's account of the collision has stayed the same in every conversation, including the initial report, the
recorded statement, and the follow-up call with counsel present. The estimate for the rear damage is largely
consistent with the described impact, and no earlier damage to the vehicle has been found.
2023-11-25
The policy was in force on the date of loss, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
The driver lives with the policyholder and qualifies as a covered household member. The file is bieng held for review
of the treatment records before any setltement position is set.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
